Complete list of all new Pokémon introduced in 2026. Learn about the latest Pokémon, their types, stats, abilities, and how to get them in current games.

2026 has been an exciting year for Pokémon fans, with new Pokémon introduced through DLC, events, and distributions. This guide covers all the new Pokémon released in 2026, their types, stats, abilities, and how to obtain them.

Table of Contents

  1. Overview of New Pokémon
  2. New Paradox Pokémon
  3. Event-Exclusive Pokémon
  4. New Mega Evolutions
  5. Tips for Catching New Pokémon

Overview of New Pokémon

The Pokémon franchise continues to expand its roster with new creatures introduced through various channels. In 2026, new Pokémon have been added through Pokémon Scarlet and Violet DLC updates, special event distributions, and Pokémon GO updates.

Each new Pokémon brings unique typing, abilities, and stats that can change the competitive landscape. Whether you are a casual player or a competitive battler, staying up to date with new Pokémon is essential for building the best teams.

New Paradox Pokémon

Paradox Pokémon are ancient or futuristic relatives of existing Pokémon, introduced in Generation 9. These Pokémon have unique typings and stats that set them apart from their modern counterparts. In 2026, several new Paradox Pokémon were added through DLC updates.

Notable new Paradox Pokémon include past forms of popular Pokémon with enhanced stats and unique abilities. These Pokémon are typically found in Area Zero and require specific conditions to encounter.

Event-Exclusive Pokémon

Event-exclusive Pokémon are distributed through special events and cannot be obtained through normal gameplay. In 2026, several rare and powerful Pokémon were distributed through online events:

  • Mythical Pokémon distributions: Rare Mythical Pokémon available through code distributions.
  • Shiny Legendary Pokémon: Shiny versions of popular Legendaries available through 7-star Tera Raids.
  • Special Pikachu variants: Pikachu wearing unique outfits for special occasions.

New Mega Evolutions

While Mega Evolution was absent from Generation 8, it made a return in Generation 9 with new Mega Stones and new Mega Evolutions. In 2026, several new Mega Evolutions were added, giving new life to old favorites.

New Mega Evolutions typically feature significant stat boosts, new abilities, and sometimes new typings. They can be obtained by finding the corresponding Mega Stone in specific locations throughout the Paldea region.

Tips for Catching New Pokémon

Catching new Pokémon can be challenging, especially if they are rare or have low catch rates. Here are some tips:

  • Use the right Poké Balls: Ultra Balls and Dusk Balls are effective for most situations.
  • Inflict status: Sleep and Paralysis increase catch rates significantly.
  • Lower HP: The lower the HP, the easier it is to catch.
  • Use False Swipe: This move always leaves 1 HP, making it safe for catching.
  • Save before encounters: Always save before encountering a rare Pokémon.
